instruction: Buy me a external hard drive on amazon under $50 (excluding tax), over 3.8 rating, and over 6 reviews, and have it delivered to work address.
notes: Single-app purchase task. The product is a runtime entity: amazon.search_products (query/product_type 'external hard drive', max_price 50, min_product_rating 3.8) yields candidates; amazon.show_product verifies the strict constraints (price < 50 excluding tax, rating > 3.8, number of reviews > 6) before the product is added to the cart. add_product_to_cart is called with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order has exactly one order item (cart changes are ignored by the evaluation). supervisor.show_addresses reveals the Work address details and amazon.show_addresses supplies the matching amazon address_id; an existing amazon payment card is used (no address/card is updated or deleted). place_order with that card and address creates the single required amazon.Order; supervisor.complete_task is called last with no answer. If several search results exist, the agent may repeat show_product on candidates until one satisfies all constraints.

plan: (amazon-add-address work-address-name work-address-street work-address-city work-address-state work-address-country work-address-zip amazon-token work-address)
